articles.summary: (Columbia, MO) August __, 2026 – Caldwell®, a leading innovator in shooting and range equipment, today announced that its ClayCopter Surface-to-Air™ Pro Kit has won the 2026 Frank Desomma Innovation of the Year Award from the Industry Choice Awards (ICA), marking the second consecutive year that Caldwell® has earned the prestigious honor. The annual award recognizes a single product that demonstrates exceptional innovation, design, or performance that stands out in the outdoor industry – this year, ICA chose to recognize the latest evolution of Caldwell’s ClayCopter® platform and its most advanced launcher to date, the ClayCopter Surface-to-Air™ Launcher.Read Full Story >>
articles.title: Caldwell ClayCopter Surface-to-Air™ Wins 2026 Frank Desomma Innovation of the Year Award
